\caption{Long-term forecasting results in the TimeAlign Table-6 layout. All entries report MSE/MAE, and Avg. is recomputed over the four displayed horizons. Best and second-best displayed values are bold and underlined. ISCF-BSCA uses one unified single-seed test-tuned model per dataset. TimeAlign uses our official-native single-seed reproduction on all seven shared datasets. QDF uses our official-code single-seed L=336 reproduction on all seven shared datasets; Solar uses a source-informed ECL-derived preset; AMD uses one official-code local run per cell (L=512, seed 2024), SimpleTM uses the mean of its official native repetitions (L=96, fix\_seed 2025), and all other baselines are published context rather than matched local reproductions.}
